title: Possible memory leak / retained memory after closing RDP sessions
author: Buster-de
body_snippet:
During testing with `mRemoteNG-nightly-20260909-v1.83.0-00cd029-x64.msi` to validate issue #179, I noticed that opening an RDP connection increases the process's memory usage (active private working set) by roughly 300 MB in my environment.

After opening and closing several RDP connections, including closing their tabs and panels, the allocated memory does not appear to be released.

How to reproduce
